jobs.description_text: ABOUT ABUNDANT AI models rely on two fundamental ingredients: compute and data. Abundant is building the NVIDIA of training data. NVIDIA, the leader in compute, has a peak market cap of $5T and generated $130B in revenue last year as the need for scaling compute has exploded. We believe the need to scale data is just beginning, as we move beyond SFT and human supervision to RL and Learning from Experience. Our founding team consists of former founders, ML engineers, roboticists and data leads from Waymo, Google, Mercor and AWS. Our team has previously worked with DeepMind to deploy deep learning models at 1B user scale, trained SOTA models for self-driving at Waymo, and scaled data pipelines of tens of thousands of human annotators at YouTube. Our pioneering work in human computation, synthetic data, simulation and RL give us the advantage in delivering results to our customers. Why now? Training data is more important and more scarce than ever before. Scaling laws dictate that linear improvement in model performance demands an exponential increase in training data. But there is only one World Wide Web and most of it has already been trained on. The next advances will require major advances in simulation, synthetic data and learning from experience. What happens if we succeed? Abundant will be the core enabler for not only AGI, but ASI and physical intelligence. Most of the challenges in model algorithms and compute are already solved. You will set the technical direction, stand up the infrastructure, and do the hands-on work yourself. COMPENSATION Adaptive has raised $146M from top-tier investors including BCV, a16z, NVIDIA, and OpenAI. Then the engagement closed, the environment changed the next week, and nobody walked that kill chain again until next year's test. Armadin is built to end that cycle. We're building an agentic attacker swarm. These are specialized AI agents running custom models that discover, exploit, and chain vulnerabilities across external, internal, identity, cloud, and application attack surfaces. They run continuously, at machine speed, against live production environments. Until recently, nobody could put a nation-state-caliber adversary inside every network around the clock. That's the hyperattack, and it's what we do. In one recent engagement, the swarm generated more than 17 million offensive actions in three days and validated 38 attack paths. jobs.title: Senior Red Team Operator, Network
jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW Every operator knows the ending. You found the path, chained it to access the crown jewel, and wrote it up. Then the engagement closed, the environment changed the next week, and nobody walked that kill chain again until next year's test. Armadin is built to end that cycle. We're building an agentic attacker swarm. These are specialized AI agents running custom models that discover, exploit, and chain vulnerabilities across external, internal, identity, cloud, and application attack surfaces. They run continuously, at machine speed, against live production environments. Until recently, nobody could put a nation-state-caliber adversary inside every network around the clock. That's the hyperattack, and it's what we do. In one recent engagement, the swarm generated more than 17 million offensive actions in three days. That's the scale your tradecraft will run at. As a Senior Red Team Operator, your tradecraft is the training signal. You'll run hands-on operations, and then you'll encode how you think into the reasoning our agents use at scale: how you pick a foothold, abuse trust between domains, pivot through identity, separate what's actually exploitable from scanner noise, and map the blast radius once you're in. You'll pressure-test full kill chains end to end, find where the swarm is naive, and teach it to move like an expert, using AI throughout your own workflow to go faster and deeper. jobs.title: Principal/Senior Scientist, Ensemble–Function Mapping
jobs.description_text: ABOUT PRISM: Prism is making protein motion measurable, predictable, and actionable. Proteins are always moving, and that movement drives their function: binding, catalysis, allostery, selectivity, and mutational effects all emerge from conformational ensembles, the distribution of states a protein moves between. Yet most structural data rests on static snapshots that capture form, not function, because motion has been hard to measure and interpret. As a result, we lack critical levers to correct proteins in disease and engineer them for new purposes. Prism is building open, usable tools, methods, and infrastructure to study protein dynamics from experimental data, and applying them to pressing biological questions, including binding affinity, enzyme engineering, and explaining pathogenic variants. Prism sits with Radial, Astera’s Life Sciences Division. ABOUT RADIAL: Radial is Astera's life sciences division. We tackle foundational problems in biology while simultaneously prototyping better ways to fund, organize, and share research. Radial builds programs in-house, funds external teams, and designs partnerships in service of public-good science. POSITION SUMMARY: The Astera Institute is seeking a full-time Senior Scientist, Ensemble–Function Mapping to lead a computational team that turns conformational ensembles into predictions of protein function. jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, Precision Instrumentation
jobs.description_text: COMPANY OVERVIEW Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy. POSITION SUMMARY As a Hardware Engineer, you will design and build the physical systems our experiments depend on, most of which don't exist commercially. Working directly with scientists, you will take a project from a well-specified plan or a rough idea through design, fabrication, and iteration until it works for the experiment. The work crosses mechanical design, fabrication, electronics, and optics, often within a single project. jobs.title: Senior Roboticist
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROBOTICS LAB We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action. Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence. Building on our existing research results and working robotic systems, we are seeking a few senior roboticists to advance our robotics capabilities and lead technical execution. POSITION SUMMARY You will contribute to the robotics research and engineering effort within a multidisciplinary team spanning robotics, AI, and computational neuroscience. jobs.description_text: About the Role As the Thermal-Mechanical Engineer for Integration of the Power Conversion System (PCS), you will own how heat moves through the PCS, including the thermal budget and its impact on hardware over time. Your scope runs from the system-level thermal energy budget down to the insulation on a single hot-section joint. You will develop the heat rejection and cold-sink architecture that closes the cycle, size and integrate the recuperator, define the thermal configuration of the hot section (insulation, heat-loss budget, surface temperatures, and personnel protection), and hold the thermal interfaces and transient requirements against the major PCS components, the reactor, and the safety systems. You are responsible for managing temperature-related life-limited hardware including mitigations, inspection procedures and processes, and a maintenance plan that manages that risk. You will participate in testing and data reviews for test rigs, full-scale hardware, and deployed reactors. You will drive instrumentation placement, correlate your models against what the PCS actually does, and take the delta back into the design. The ideal candidate is fluent in heat transfer across conduction, convection, and radiation; has sized real thermal hardware rather than only analyzed it; and is comfortable owning the heat-loss budget and cold-sink margin, working with component owners to ensure thermal performance is met. jobs.title: Base Labs Research Scientist - RL Environments
jobs.description_text: ABOUT BASE LABS Base Labs is Baseten’s research lab, working to advance and democratize open-source intelligence. We publish our research, methods, and results so others can inspect, reproduce, and build on them. Baseten’s training and inference infrastructure gives us a place to test ideas at scale, while our work with companies deploying models keeps us close to the problems those models need to solve. THE ROLE Models learn from the environments we give them. If a reward is easier to exploit than a task is to solve, a model can learn the shortcut. If a task measures the wrong capability, a higher score tells us little about progress. Building good environments requires decisions about what to teach, how to measure it, and how to establish whether it transfers. As a Research Scientist at Base Labs specializing in RL environments, you will create open environments and study how models learn from them. You will design tasks and rewards, develop methods for generating and calibrating environments at scale, and run the training experiments needed to understand their effects. There is substantial reinforcement learning research in this work. We want to understand how task diversity affects generalization, how curricula should change as models improve, and which reward structures produce reliable learning. Your findings will inform both the environments we release and the broader lab’s training research. RESPONSIBILITIES - Identify capabilities and failure modes worth studying, in

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Runtime - Storage
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Container runtimes were designed for general-purpose software workloads. AI inference is not a general-purpose workload. Running large models at production scale exposes cracks in every layer of the container stack: runtimes unaware of GPU memory constraints, images that take minutes to pull when a model needs to scale to thousands of replicas, and isolation mechanisms that weren’t designed for the multi-tenant serving environments that production AI requires. The tools the industry has relied on for a decade weren’t built for this, and patching around those limitations at higher layers only goes so far. Baseten owns the entire pipeline, from the moment a developer pushes a model to the moment a request gets a response. That vertical ownership means we can fix these problems at the root. The Runtime Fabric team is doing exactly that: purpose-building the container runtime and storage layers for AI inference workloads, led by some of the world’s top containerd maintainers. As Engineering Manager for Storage Products on the Runtime Fabric team, you will lead the engineers who build and run the storage products behind that stack: the Baseten Delivery Network (BDN), which sits in the cold start path of every model on the platform, the snapshotters and filesystems that expose model weights and container images to a running container, and the storage that model deployment and training need next. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Compute & Isolation (Agent Infra)
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes gets its own microVM, where it writes and runs code, calls tools, and keeps state across long tasks. Agents pause and resume constantly, so the machine underneath has to start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume fast, and keep every tenant isolated while it does. General-purpose virtualization was not built for that workload. The Agent Infra team builds that layer. Sandboxes run in microVMs with custom Linux kernels on bare-metal servers we operate. You'll own how sandboxes start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume, and how they perform on each host's CPU and memory, down to the hardware. You'll also own the guest and host side of each sandbox: its identity, how it attaches to different storage classes for performance or capabilities, and the virtual devices that connect it securely to the network. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose microVM sandboxes are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes. We are building a cloud, not just using one. That means designing for many tenants from day one and thinking through what each decision means all the way down to the datacenter. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. If you've worked deep in KVM and Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, or QEMU and want to build the computers AI agents run on, we'd love to talk. EXA

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Networking (Agent Infra)
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes runs in its own microVM. Agents call models, reach tools and APIs, expose services, and more and more often talk to each other. Networking built into today's cloud providers was not designed for very large numbers of isolated machines that suspend, resume, and exchange data constantly. The Agent Infra team builds its own networking stack for sandboxes, designed from the start for that scale. It runs in user space, with VPP (FD.io http://FD.io) as its main data plane technology, and is built from virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV): carrier-grade, low-latency packet processing designed for very large numbers of agents. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes, storage, and networking are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes. You'll build multi-tenant virtual private networking that connects each customer's agents and services privately and securely, using modern overlay technologies. We are building a cloud, not just using one. We want engineers who expose the network as a programmable API and write the code, not operators who push router and switch configuration. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. This role is separate from Baseten's GPU-to-GPU networking. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files. The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes. We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk. EXAMPLE INITIATIVES - Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/ - Baseten Sandboxes documentation https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes RESPONSIBILITIES - Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement

jobs.description_text: Life Science On-site ■ Company Overview Cheiron is building AI software for regulatory lifecycle management in the pharmaceutical industry, and we are working with our first pilot customers. The platform keeps track of what is registered in each market (the approved state, commitments and conditions, and the filings needed to keep registrations current) and, when a manufacturing or quality change is proposed, works out what it means in each market for review by qualified regulatory staff. It also drafts and checks regulatory documents. Customers keep their own regulatory records, and their qualified staff make the formal decisions; Cheiron supports that work. Cheiron raised an $11 million seed round led by Menlo Ventures, bringing total funding to $16 million to date, with the backing and strategic support of industry veterans including Moderna co-founder and MIT Institute Professor Robert Langer, former Pfizer Chief Medical Officer Freda Lewis-Hall, Chai Discovery co-founder and CEO Josh Meier, former Starbucks CEO Laxman Narasimhan, and former Apple AI chief John Giannandrea. ■ About the Role Bring hands-on regulatory judgment to AI that runs the registered life of a product. You will work alongside AI that produces first drafts, assessments and checks. Your judgment decides what is right, and your work makes the system better. jobs.description_text: Business On-site Frequent travel ■ Company Overview Cheiron is building an AI-native operating system for drug development: a connected view of the evidence, assumptions, risks, decisions and commitments behind a drug program. The goal is to help biopharma teams understand what is known, test their assumptions and see how a change affects the rest of a program. Our current focus is CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls): how a drug is made, tested and kept consistent throughout its commercial life. A manufacturing change can create a chain of evidence, review and submission work across markets. Today, teams piece this work together across documents, spreadsheets and institutional memory. We're building agents that connect the relevant evidence, reason through requirements and help teams prepare and review the resulting submissions. Founded in 2024 by Stanford-trained AI researchers, Cheiron is a Seed-stage company headquartered in Los Altos, California. Our team of 19 people combines AI and software engineering with experience from pharma and biotech. The platform has been adopted by tens of thousands of biopharma professionals. With $16M total raised, including an $11M seed round led by Menlo Ventures, we're building our US commercial team in Los Altos. ■ About the Role This is a founding commercial role. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and ship full-stack product features for appraisers, operations teams, and enterprise lenders. - Use AI-assisted development tools to move quickly while maintaining software quality. - Turn appraisal, compliance, and lender workflows into clear, maintainable software. - Help shape engineering culture and processes as the team grows. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Zero to three years of experience, including early-stage engineering work or shipped projects, internships, or hackathon projects. - Strong full-stack fundamentals and experience building frontend and backend components. - Daily fluency with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar. - Ability to translate real-world workflows into software, with experience building tools or internal systems for operational teams. - Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership in an early-stage environment. - Experience with regulated industries or compliance-heavy requirements is useful. - Must be authorized to work in the United States without H-1B sponsorship. jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE As an Account Executive, you will own a European territory and lead end-to-end sales for a B2B SaaS business serving traditional industries. You will build new customer relationships and grow mid-market accounts in markets that are still early in their digital transformation. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and qualify pipeline through cold outreach, trade shows, industry meetups, and direct prospecting. - Own the sales cycle from first contact through C-level negotiations and close. - Win mid-market accounts of 100 to 2,000 employees, with deal sizes of €25,000 to €40,000. - Develop existing accounts and identify opportunities for retention, upsell, and cross-sell. - Partner with BDR, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams to advance opportunities. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least 2 years of Account Executive experience in complex B2B SaaS, including independently building pipeline through cold outreach. - A track record of closing deals in the €15,000 to €20,000 range and delivering strong quota performance. - Experience selling to European traditional industries such as manufacturing, logistics, construction, or trade, ideally in mid-market accounts. - Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a comparable sales methodology. - Fluency in spoken and written German and English. - A bachelor's degree or equivalent, and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment. - Willingness to travel for trade shows, industry fairs, meetups, and customer meetings.
